title: Ashok Kumar Gupta v. State of U.P.
coram: Sunita Agarwal, J.; Sadhna Rani (Thakur), J.
disposition: Writ disposed; petitioner relegated to Clause 6.5 of the Supply Code.
headnote: A writ disputing an electricity bill on the plea that neither the petitioner nor his family had applied for a connection and that none was installed raises a question of fact. The Allahabad High Court held that the appropriate course is a representation to the Executive Engineer/SDO under Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, to be decided expeditiously in accordance with law, including any one-time settlement plea.
facts: Ashok Kumar Gupta petitioned the Allahabad High Court against the State of U.P. and Purvanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Limited officers at Azamgarh, disputing an electricity bill. He asserted that neither he nor any family member had applied for a connection at the premises and that none had been installed. After listing orders directing service of notice on the discom, the Division Bench heard counsel on 28 July 2021.

holding_units.topic: factual billing dispute remitted to Executive Engineer
holding_units.holding: Where a writ raises a factual dispute about an electricity bill—including a plea that no connection was applied for or installed—the High Court will not decide the controversy and will relegate the petitioner to the Executive Engineer/SDO under Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. If an application is filed within three weeks with a copy of the order, that officer must decide expeditiously in accordance with law; any one-time settlement plea, if raised, is also to be considered.

principle_tags.application: The writ was disposed of without deciding the bill, sending the petitioner to Clause 6.5 as the proper forum.
The Court treated the no-application/no-connection plea as a factual billing dispute for the Executive Engineer under Clause 6.5.
Clause 6.5 was identified as the statutory course for the disputed electricity bill.
The petitioner was directed to approach the Executive Engineer/SDO, PuVVNL, Electricity Distribution Division-V, Azamgarh, under Clause 6.5.
